resolution_summary: check_codex_review_finality.decision() required a completed exact-head codex-review-state strictly BEFORE the positive receipt. Natively Codex keeps ONE state comment per PR, edits it in place (content dated by updated_at), posts the receipt first and edits the state to completed 1-3 s later; an automatic re-review after ready_for_review edits the state again and posts no receipt. Replay of all 285 Codex-reviewed PRs updated since 2026-10-15: main admits 0; 90 fail POSITIVE_WITHOUT_EXACT_HEAD_COMPLETION, incl. #2323 #2324 #2325 at their exact heads. Fix: the receipt also binds when the LATEST
task_summary: governance: admit Codex reviews in their native order (receipt, then in-place state edit) (#2385)
